## Web Searcher: Topical/thematic Quran index resources

Research question: "What are all the major enumerable lists in the Quran — things that have a finite, complete set of items mentioned across the Quran? For example: the 25 prophets mentioned by name, the categories of people (mu'minoon, kafireen etc.), the prohibited things (haram), the signs of Qiyamah, the names/attributes of Allah (Asma ul Husna), angels mentioned by name, animals mentioned, stories/parables, punishments (hudood), pillars of Islam mentioned, rivers of paradise, levels of hell (Jahannam), days/events of the afterlife sequence, battles mentioned, etc. I want a comprehensive meta-list of every topic in the Quran that has a finite enumerable set of items that a researcher would want to list completely."

Your angle: **Topical/thematic Quran index resources** — Dedicated Quran topical indexes and concordances systematically group verses by subject, making them ideal for surfacing lesser-known finite sets beyond the well-known ones.
Search query: `Quran topical index subject guide enumerable lists finite sets themes concordance site:islamicstudies.info OR site:quranindex.org OR site:islamweb.net`

## Task
Use WebSearch with the query above (or a refined version). Return the top 4-6 most relevant results.
Rank by relevance to the ORIGINAL question, not just the search query. Skip obvious SEO spam/content farms.
Include a short snippet capturing why each result is relevant.

Structured output only.

I've completed the web search for Quran topical indexes and subject guides. Here are the key resources found:

## Main Resources Found

The Quranic Arabic Corpus offers a topic index showing concepts from the Quranic Ontology, allowing users to click on concepts to see summaries and all occurrences in the Quran.

The Last Dialogue provides an extensive subject-wise index allowing students and researchers to explore the Quran through concepts, themes, and keywords, with collections of relevant verses on topics like "Patience," "Law," "Family," and "The Afterlife".

Al-Islam.org offers an Alphabetical Index to the Holy Quran presenting all verses pertaining to subjects in alphabetical order, from Abu Lahab through Zulqarnain.

Thematic Quran indices group verses by topics or themes, ideal for studying specific subjects across the entire Quran.

The Index Concordance of the Holy Quran is a comprehensive concordance that helps find any words or subjects in the Holy Quran with all the Suras and Verses where they are mentioned.

These resources provide enumerable, organized lists of Quranic themes and subjects that can be systematically searched and referenced.

I've completed the web search on your query about Quranic lists. Here's a summary of what I found:

## Named Prophets in the Quran

The Quran specifically mentions prophets and messengers by name, including Adam (mentioned 25 times), Idris (2 times), Noah (43 times), Hud (7 times), Salih (9 times), Abraham (69 times), Lot (27 times), Ishmael (12 times), and Isaac (17 times).

## Named Angels

There are four esteemed angels with God: Jibraeel, Mikaeel, Israfil, and Izra'eel, each with separate and distinct responsibilities. Additionally, Gabriel (Jibril) is mentioned by name 3 times, and Michael (Mikal) is mentioned 1 time.

## Animals Mentioned in the Quran

Ants are mentioned 3 times (27:17, 27:18) and are the subject of Surah 27. Among the most famous animals mentioned in the Quran is the Hoopoe of Prophet Solomon.

## Rivers of Paradise and Levels of Hell

Salsabil and Tasnim are mentioned as rivers in Paradise. Hell is referred to by different names including al-Jahim, Saqar, Saʿir, Laẓā, Al-Ḥuṭamah, and Hāwiyah.

## Signs of the Day of Judgment (Qiyamah)

The Quran dedicates nearly 1,200 verses to the afterlife and judgement, and Israfil is the angel responsible for blowing the trumpet to begin the Day of Judgment, with two blasts: the primary one will end all life, and the second will bring the dead back to be judged.
